data.name: Rameen
data.gender_notes: Rameen is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rameen is a beautiful unisex name of Persian and Arabic origin meaning 'joyful', 'obedient', or 'one who brings happiness and peace'. It can also imply a protector or supporter in classical Persian literature. The name Rameen carries the meaning “Joyful, Obedient, Rescuer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Rameen usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, obedient, rescuer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes inner peace and loyalty — one who brings joy to others and uplifts souls with calmness and sincerity.
data.etymology: Rameen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joyful, Obedient, Rescuer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rameen total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: رامين
in_arabic.meaning: رامين يعني القائم بالشئون أو المدير أو الحافظ
in_arabic.long_meaning: رامين هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه: القائم بالشئون، المدير، الحافظ. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران الآية ١٢٩ {وَكَانَ اللَّهُ عَزِيزًا رَحِيمًا}، وقد أشتق من الفعل 'ر-م-ن' والذي يعني الحفظ والتدبير. يستخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية كدلالة على الخصال الحميدة كالحفظ والحماية.

in_urdu.name: رامین
in_urdu.meaning: رامین کا مطلب ہے شئون کا انتظام کرنے والا یا محافظ
in_urdu.long_meaning: رامین ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے شئون کا انتظام کرنے والا، محافظ یا نگہبان۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے کیونکہ یہ القران میں مذکور ہے اور اسلامی تقالید میں محافظ اور حافظ کے طور پر سمجھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रामीन
in_hindi.meaning: रामीन का अर्थ है मामलों का प्रबंध करने वाला या रक्षक
in_hindi.long_meaning: रामीन एक पुरुष नाम है जो अरबी से उत्पन्न हुआ है। इसका अर्थ है मामलों का प्रबंध करने वाला, रक्षक या संरक्षक। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है क्योंकि यह कुरआन में उल्लिखित है और इस्लामी रीति-रिवाजों में रक्षक और संरक्षक के रूप में समझा जाता है।

in_pashto.name: رامین
in_pashto.meaning: رامین د معنی دا دی چی د چارو مدیر یا ساتونکی وی
in_pashto.long_meaning: رامین د یو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې څخه سرچینه اخلي. دغه نوم د معنی یې د چارو مدیر، ساتونکی یا سرپرست دی. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو په دودیزو کړو کې د پام وړ دی او د اسلامي نړۍ کې د يو مثبت او ښه نوم په توګه پېژندل شوی دی.

in_english.name: Rameen
in_english.meaning: Rameen means manager of affairs or guardian
in_english.long_meaning: Rameen is a masculine name of Arabic origin. It means the manager of affairs, guardian, or protector. The name is derived from the Arabic root 'r-m-n' which signifies preservation and care. Rameen holds spiritual significance in Islamic tradition as it relates to divine protection and guardianship. The name is used across various Muslim cultures to signify positive attributes such as reliability and care.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rameen holds a special place in both Persian and Arab cultures, representing joy, obedience, and even a protector or supporter. In Persian literature, Rameen is often used as the name of a hero or a cherished companion, signifying the importance of companionship, loyalty, and support in these societies.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name Rameen holds a deeper meaning as it symbolizes joy which comes from living a virtuous life, being obedient to the faith and in the service of others, particularly referring to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and his companions. The name also connotes the level of peace and contentment that comes from a deep connection to God, and can bring happiness even in trying times by reminding that joy comes from within. It serves as a reminder that true joy and happiness come from living a cherished and fulfilling life rooted in the teachings of one's faith.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Rameen in Arabic means "gentle, kind, and compassionate." It is a name that evokes images of a loving and caring individual, who goes out of their way to comfort and support others. May Allah grant us all the qualities of Rameen and inspire us to spread kindness and compassion in the world.
